title: High Speed Chase Of Stolen Vehicle Ends In Rollover Crash
description:
* (Disclaimer: The content in this video is intended for educational and informational purposes only)
Fond du Lac County, Wisconsin — On Friday, May 8, 2026, at approximately 1:08 p.m. the Fond du Lac County Sheriff’s Office received an alert of a stolen vehicle out of Illinois traveling northbound on Interstate 41 from County Road Y. Further information was gathered that the vehicle was involved in two different pursuits in the past week in Illinois, but eluded officers each time. A short time later a deputy with the Fond du Lac County Sheriff’s Office located the vehicle on Interstate 4 and conducted a high-risk traffic stop. The vehicle initially pulled over and stopped, but a short time the suspect vehicle fled. A pursuit ensued northbound on Interstate 41 into Winnebago County. The suspect vehicle failed to obey the deputies’ emergency lights and sirens. The suspect vehicle increased its speed in attempt to evade apprehension. As the pursuit continued into Winnebago County the suspect vehicle continued to exhibit reckless behavior by passing other vehicles on the interstate, including passing on the shoulder, weaving between vehicles, and all at a high rate of speed. The pursuit continued until the suspect vehicle entered a field near County Road Z and Clay Rd in Winnebago County. As a Sergeant with the Sheriff’s Office was moving in to perform a Pursuit Intervention Technique (PIT Maneuver), contact was made with the suspect vehicle as the suspect had placed his vehicle in reverse and rammed into the front of the squad. 

The suspect vehicle then attempted to leave the field by traveling through a ditch and back up onto Clay Road where another Sheriff’s Office squad ended the pursuit by intentionally striking the suspect, pushing the vehicle off the road and back into the ditch. The suspect vehicle rolled over in the ditch, came to rest upright, and was ultimately disabled effectively ending the pursuit. Two occupants exited the vehicle and were taken into custody. The suspect vehicle started on fire and required a fire department respond to extinguish the fire. Both occupants were evaluated by medical personnel on scene. The driver of the vehicle was identified as 23-year-old Antonie Wells from Des Plaines, Illinois. Wells was taken to the Fond du Lac County Jail on charges of Fleeing/Eluding Officer, two counts of 1st Degree Reckless Endangering Safety, Resisting/Obstructing Officer, and Delivering Illegal Articles by Inmate (Ecstasy pills). Wells’s criminal history through Illinois was flagged as armed and dangerous with previous weapons offenses, dangerous drug offenses, and criminal damage to property. The passenger of the vehicle was identified as 23-year-old Crystal Olcikas from Franklin Park, Illinois. Olcikas was taken to the Fond du Lac County Jail on the charges of Fleeing/Eluding-Party to a Crime, 1st Degree Reckless Endangering Safety-Party to a Crime. Possession of THC, Possession of Drug Paraphernalia, and Resisting and Obstructing an Officer.
